description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableAcknowledgement' implementing the 'Acknowledgement' interface, representing an acknowledgment message with various properties such as label, entity ID, status code, headers, and optional payload. It includes methods for creating instances, accessing properties, serializing to JSON, and utility methods like equals and hashCode.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgement
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Acknowledgement interface representing a structured acknowledgment message with various properties and JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ImmutableAcknowledgement with specified label, entity ID, status code, headers, and optional payload.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the acknowledgment.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the acknowledgment.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Determines whether the acknowledgment indicates success based on label and status code.

methods.name: isTimeout
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment status indicates a timeout.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the acknowledgment.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the payload as an optional JsonValue, considering schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new acknowledgment instance with the specified payload.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders associated with the acknowledgment.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new acknowledgment instance with the provided DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type of the associated entity ID.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string type of the acknowledgment based on entity type.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the acknowledgment to a JsonObject based on schema version and predicate.
